citation: Qiu et al. (2015), The Pacific North Equatorial Current: New Insights from the Origins of the Kuroshio and Mindanao Currents (OKMC) Project, Oceanography28(4),24-33.

nominal_surface_width.locator: Printed25 / PDF3, Introduction first paragraph; time-mean discussion in right column; Figure2a on printed26 / PDF4
nominal_surface_width.geographic_scope: Western Pacific, west of the dateline; no source-specified single meridian or complete longitudinal footprint.
nominal_surface_width.layer: Nominal near-surface band shallower than100m; associated mapped velocity panel averages0-100m.
nominal_surface_width.layer_bounds_role: Associated time-mean geostrophic velocity panel, not a statement that every instantaneous depth has these edges.
nominal_surface_width.quantity: Author-described nominal meridional span of the surface westward current.

underlying_study_context.citation: Qiu, Chen, Rudnick and Kashino (2015), A New Paradigm for the North Pacific Subthermocline Low-Latitude Western Boundary Current System, Journal of Physical Oceanography45,2407-2423.
underlying_study_context.method: Geostrophic velocities computed from objectively mapped temperature/salinity, referenced to zero velocity at2000m; associated surface panel averages0-100m.
underlying_study_context.period_handling: The float period does not date all historical CTD/XCTD profiles or define a uniform observation window for the synthesis width.
underlying_study_context.source_difference: The underlying study describes7-17N, whereas the later synthesis describes a nominal8-17N span. Preserve source-specific bands; do not merge them into one range or two independent observations.

separations: The near-surface band and deeper poleward extension are different vertical supports.
A latitude separation is cross-current regional extent, not whole-current length or independently diagnosed flow-normal width.
Nominal limits describe source context; no current footprint, mapped edge coordinates or state intersection is admitted.
No seasonal envelope or confidence interval follows from the difference between the two source descriptions.
